name: SDXL 1.0 and its ecosystem
publisher: Stability AI (base, refiner, SDXL-Turbo, Control-LoRAs); ByteDance (SDXL-Lightning, Hyper-SD); latent-consistency (LCM-LoRA); xinsir (ControlNet Union); Tencent (IP-Adapter); fine-tunes by RunDiffusion (Juggernaut), SG161222 (RealVisXL), OnomaAI (Illustrious), Civitai community (Pony)

gated_downloads.note: none of the SDXL files used by the recipes is gated (base, refiner, Turbo, Lightning, DMD2, Union, clip_vision_g are open downloads). Pony Diffusion V6 XL is a Civitai download (exact filename NOT FOUND).

cannot.what: legible text: 'The model cannot render legible text' (base card; Turbo card too) - use SD3.5 / Qwen-Image / Z-Image for typography
compositional instructions: 'struggles with more difficult tasks which involve compositionality, such as rendering an image corresponding to "A red cube on top of a blue sphere"'
perfect photorealism and faces: 'The model does not achieve perfect photorealism'; 'Faces and people in general may not be generated properly'; 'The autoencoding part of the model is lossy'
resolutions far from ~1 MP (trained buckets 1024x1024 ... 1536x640); Turbo is 'fixed resolution (512x512 pix)'
image prompting beyond concepts: ReVision 'will take concepts from the images' - identity/style locking needs IP-Adapter, which needs the ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus pack (pending)
Hyper-SD 1-step variants without custom nodes (ComfyUI-TCD for the unified LoRA; the repo's ComfyUI-HyperSDXL1StepUnetScheduler for the 1-step UNet)

params.name: steps
params.meaning: denoise steps; on base+refiner the TOTAL on both samplers
params.interactions: Lightning: steps MUST equal the checkpoint's N; Hyper-SD CFG LoRAs 8 or 12; LCM 'very few'

params.name: cfg
params.meaning: classifier-free guidance; template note: 'recommended max 10 ... too high ... "burn-in"'
params.interactions: at cfg 1 ComfyUI skips the negative pass (docs); Turbo/Lightning/DMD2 above 1 oversaturate (guidance 0 in diffusers)

params.name: sampler_name / scheduler

defaults.lightning: euler / sgm_uniform (publisher: 'Please use Euler sampler with sgm_uniform scheduler')
defaults.lcm-lora: lcm / sgm_uniform or simple (+ ModelSamplingDiscrete lcm)

params.interactions: template note: 'different samplers and schedulers have better results with fewer steps, while others have better success with higher steps'

params.name: denoise
params.meaning: img2img strength: 'the smaller the denoise value, the smaller the difference ... If denoise is 1 ... same as the empty latent'
params.interactions: 'ComfyUI builds a schedule for steps / denoise steps (rounded down) and keeps only its last steps + 1 sigmas'; KSamplerAdvanced uses start/end steps instead

params.name: width / height
params.interactions: off-bucket sizes degrade SDXL (template note, card); img2img / inpaint take the input image's size

params.name: seed
params.meaning: randomize in the templates; base+refiner: only the base adds noise so the refiner's seed is irrelevant; Turbo template keeps it fixed for Auto Queue

params.name: refiner switch-over
params.meaning: where the base hands the noisy latent to the refiner
params.interactions: base: add_noise enable, start 0, return_with_leftover_noise enable; refiner: add_noise disable, end 10000, leftover disable; same total steps; refiner prompts on the REFINER CLIP, decode with the REFINER VAE

params.name: ascore
params.meaning: aesthetic-score conditioning for the refiner (not used by the templates, which use plain CLIPTextEncode)

defaults.docs: 7.5 positive ('the standard setting used in SDXL training'), 2.0-3.0 for negatives

params.name: clip skip
params.meaning: stop the text encoder N layers early; ComfyUI counts -1..-12 (A1111 1..12)

defaults.dmd2 lora: 1.0 ('we might want to make the scale smaller for community models')

params.name: strength / start_percent / end_percent
params.interactions: several ControlNets chain through successive ControlNetApplyAdvanced nodes; the vae input is optional for SDXL ControlNets

params.name: union type
params.meaning: which condition the Union network should apply
params.interactions: the dossier's v0.38.1 names (canny, scribble, seg, inpaint, lineart, blur, mlsd, normalbae, mask) are not valid on this box

params.name: unCLIP strength / noise_augmentation
params.meaning: how much of the reference image's concept enters the positive conditioning (ReVision)
params.interactions: zero the text (ConditioningZeroOut) 'for the final output to follow the input image more closely'

params.name: grow_mask_by
params.meaning: pixels to dilate the inpaint mask

rules.message: SDXL is a 4-channel latent (latent_formats.SDXL): EmptyLatentImage, never the 16-channel EmptySD3LatentImage
EmptyLatentImage takes width/height in multiples of 8 (node step 8; 8x VAE)

not an SDXL trained bucket (template note: 'it is recommended to use trained values': 1024x1024, 1152x896, 896x1152, 1216x832, 832x1216, 1344x768, 768x1344, 1536x640, 640x1536); 512x512 is SDXL-Turbo's native size only
SDXL-Turbo: 'Preferably, the model generates images of size 512x512' ('higher image sizes work as well'); the card lists 'fixed resolution (512x512 pix)' as a limitation

the baked SDXL VAE 'generates NaNs in fp16 because the internal activation values are too big' -> black/grey images on some cards (reports on SDXL-Lightning and the refiner). The official templates decode with the baked VAE anyway; answer 'fine' when the box decodes in bf16/fp32 or the output is not black, otherwise add VAELoader(sdxl_vae.safetensors from madebyollin/sdxl-vae-fp16-fix) into VAEDecode

base + refiner run as two chained KSamplerAdvanced: base (model from the base checkpoint; add_noise enable; start_at_step 0; end_at_step = switch; return_with_leftover_noise enable) feeding the refiner (model from the refiner checkpoint; add_noise disable; start_at_step = switch; end_at_step 10000; return_with_leftover_noise disable), SAME total steps on both, the refiner's positive/negative encoded with the REFINER checkpoint's CLIP, VAEDecode with the REFINER VAE. Template: these settings 'SHOULD stay in place if you want this workflow to work correctly'; breaking them gives over-noised or double-noised output
the refiner is 'specialized for the final denoising steps' of a latent the base produced; alone it is a weak img2img model with only the OpenCLIP-G encoder

SDXL-Turbo 'does not make use of guidance_scale or negative_prompt, we disable it with guidance_scale=0.0'; Lightning 'CFG set to 0' - in ComfyUI that is cfg 1.0 (the negative pass is skipped); above 1 the distilled models oversaturate
Lightning / DMD2 / non-CFG Hyper-SD LoRAs are guidance-0 distillations: cfg 1.0 in ComfyUI. Only the Hyper-SDXL-{8,12}steps-CFG-lora files keep cfg (5-8)
'Please always use the correct checkpoint for the corresponding inference steps': the 2-step Lightning files run at exactly 2 steps
'Please always use the correct checkpoint for the corresponding inference steps': the 4-step Lightning files run at exactly 4 steps
'Please always use the correct checkpoint for the corresponding inference steps': the 8-step Lightning files run at exactly 8 steps
SDXL-Lightning: 'Please use Euler sampler with sgm_uniform scheduler'
SDXL-Lightning: 'Please use Euler sampler with sgm_uniform scheduler'
DMD2 samples with the LCM scheduler (timesteps [999, 749, 499, 249] for 4 steps, [399] for 1 step): the lcm sampler in ComfyUI
the DMD2 4-step LoRA is trained for exactly 4 steps
the Hyper-SD CFG-preserving LoRAs 'support 5~8 guidance scales' at 8 (or 12) steps - they are the ones that keep a working negative prompt
the unified Hyper-SD 1-step LoRA needs the TCD scheduler ('Remember to install ComfyUI-TCD ... adjust the eta parameter'); TCDScheduler is not in ComfyUI v0.35.0 - a custom pack (JettHu/ComfyUI-TCD)
LCM-LoRA: 'use a low cfg, use the lcm sampler and the sgm_uniform or simple scheduler. The ModelSamplingDiscrete node with lcm set as the sampling option will slightly improve results'
'The proper way to use it is with the new SDTurboScheduler node' feeding SamplerCustom (the sdxlturbo_example graph); a plain KSampler works but is not the official route

the xinsir ControlNet Union is one network for 10+ conditions: ControlNetLoader -> SetUnionControlNetType(type) -> ControlNetApplyAdvanced; without the type node the condition is not selected ('auto' is a legal choice)

on ComfyUI v0.35.0 SetUnionControlNetType.type is one of: auto, openpose, depth, hed/pidi/scribble/ted, canny/lineart/anime_lineart/mlsd, normal, segment, tile, repaint (comfy/cldm/control_types.py); the newer names (canny, scribble, seg, inpaint, lineart, blur, mlsd, normalbae, mask) are rejected
ControlNetApply ('Apply ControlNet (DEPRECATED)') is deprecated in the v0.35.0 registry: use ControlNetApplyAdvanced (positive + negative, strength, start/end)

Pony Diffusion V6 XL: 'Make sure you load this model with clip skip 2, otherwise you will be getting low quality blobs' -> CLIPSetLastLayer stop_at_clip_layer -2 between the checkpoint CLIP and both text encoders (A1111 counts 1..12, ComfyUI -1..-12)
the recipe's template needs a newer ComfyUI than the pinned image (none of the SDXL templates does: all 0.0.1)

prompting.negative_gloss: the ComfyUI_examples SDXL templates' negative; image_sdxl_simple ships the prompt-specific 'color, colored, lowres, blurry, out of focus, deformed, bad anatomy, extra limbs, mutated, watermark, text, logo, signature\n' (its 'color, colored' belongs to its black-and-white statue); Turbo / Lightning / DMD2: no negative (cfg 1)

positive.line: Short tag-like phrases work ('evening sunset scenery blue sky nature, glass bottle with a galaxy in it'); so does prose ('a giant classical marble statue standing alone in a pure white empty void, soft diffused lighting, ...')
Refiner prompts 'should emphasize desired visual effects rather than scene content'
Juggernaut XL v9: 'Negative Prompts: start with none. Add specific things you don't want as you iterate'
RealVisXL V5.0 negative: 'bad hands, bad anatomy, ugly, deformed, (face asymmetry, eyes asymmetry, deformed eyes, deformed mouth, open mouth)'

Pony V6 XL prefix: 'score_9, score_8_up, score_7_up, score_6_up, score_5_up, score_4_up, just describe what you want, tag1, tag2'; source tags source_pony / source_furry / source_cartoon / source_anime; rating tags rating_safe / rating_questionable / rating_explicit; negative 'Generally not needed'; clip skip 2

Illustrious XL: Danbooru tags; quality tags worst quality / bad quality / average quality / good quality / best quality / masterpiece; composition tags ('upper body', 'cowboy shot', 'portrait'); 'Avoid overusing critical composition tags that may conflict'
Two encoders: CLIPTextEncodeSDXL takes text_g (OpenCLIP-G) and text_l (CLIP-L) separately plus size/crop conditioning; the official templates use one shared prompt

hurts.line: asking for legible text ('The model cannot render legible text')
compositional instructions ('A red cube on top of a blue sphere')
negatives and cfg > 1 on Turbo / Lightning / DMD2
Pony without clip skip 2 and the score tags; Illustrious without quality tags

pitfalls.cause: base return_with_leftover_noise not 'enable', refiner add_noise not 'disable', or start_at_step != base end_at_step, or different total steps
pitfalls.fix: the t2i-base-refiner wiring (template: settings that 'SHOULD stay in place')

pitfalls.symptom: refiner ignores its prompt / wrong colours

pitfalls.fix: encode the refiner prompts with the REFINER checkpoint's CLIP and decode with its VAE (the template does both)

pitfalls.symptom: soft, deformed, duplicated subjects at an odd size
fried / oversaturated output from a distilled model

pitfalls.fix: cfg 1; Lightning: steps = checkpoint's N, euler + sgm_uniform; DMD2: 4 steps, lcm
